why: failed AI calls cost nothing, history lists charges and refunds, shown in Settings in both languages, tests and changelog
prompt:
Support ticket: "My project cover came back as failed, and 15 credits were gone anyway. Same thing happened earlier with a character sheet."
Users must not pay for AI work that failed. Fix it everywhere credits are charged, not only for covers. Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Users want to see where their credits went. Add `GET /api/v1/workspaces/{id}/credits/history`: the workspace's credit changes, newest first, with every charge, refund and daily refill. Each item has `amount` (negative for a charge), `action` and `created_at`. A refunded charge and its refund both appear.
Only members of the workspace may read it; to anyone else the workspace does not exist (404). Add tests.
On the Settings page, under the credit balance, show this history: when, what it was for, and the amount, with refunds marked as refunds. Both languages.

report.answer: The Settings page now shows a credit history table under the balance, with when, what it was for and the amount. Refunds get a green "Refund" badge and a "Refund: <action>" label, and the table says so if the history is empty or fails to load. All text is in both en.json and ko.json under `Settings.creditHistory`, with matching keys, and `tsc` passes. ESLint reports no errors on the page, only 7 warnings. I did not open the page in a browser.

+    def refund_credits(self, session: Session, workspace_id: UUID, user_id: UUID, action_type: str) -> None:
+        """
+        Gives back the credits charged for an AI action that failed and
+        records a refund transaction. Never raises, so it is safe to call
+        from error handlers.
+        """
+        try:
+            session.rollback()
+            workspace = session.get(Workspace, workspace_id)
+            if not workspace:
+                return
+            tier = workspace.tier if workspace.tier else "free"
+            cost = self.PRICING.get(action_type, {}).get(tier, 5)
+            workspace.credits += cost
+            session.add(workspace)
+            session.add(CreditTransaction(
+                workspace_id=workspace_id,
+                user_id=user_id,
+                amount=cost,
+                action_type=f"refund_{action_type}",
+                timestamp=datetime.utcnow()
+            ))
+            session.commit()
+        except Exception:
+            session.rollback()
+
+    def refund_credits_detached(self, workspace_id: UUID, user_id: UUID, action_type: str) -> None:
+        """Refund from a background task, using a fresh session."""
+        from app.db.engine import engine
+        with Session(engine) as session:
+            self.refund_credits(session, workspace_id, user_id, action_type)
+
+    @contextmanager
+    def refund_on_failure(self, session: Session, workspace_id: UUID, user_id: UUID, action_type: str):
+        """Refunds the charge if the wrapped AI work raises, then re-raises."""
+        try:
+            yield
+        except Exception:
+            self.refund_credits(session, workspace_id, user_id, action_type)

diff --git a/backend/tests/test_credit_refunds.py b/backend/tests/test_credit_refunds.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..205016e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/backend/tests/test_credit_refunds.py
@@ -0,0 +1,134 @@
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import FakeGemini
+
+API = "/api/v1"
+
+
+def credits(client, h):
+    return client.get(f"{API}/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"]
+
+
+def make_project(client, h):
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()["id"]
+
+
+def make_character(client, h, project_id):
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/characters", headers=h, json={"name": "Mina", "project_id": project_id})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()["id"]
+
+
+def test_failed_cover_is_refunded(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    project = client.get(f"{API}/projects/{pid}", headers=h).json()
+    assert project["cover_image_status"] == "failed"
+    assert credits(client, h) == 500
+
+
+def test_successful_cover_is_charged(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/projects/{pid}", headers=h).json()["cover_image_status"] == "completed"
+    assert credits(client, h) == 485
+
+
+def test_failed_character_sheet_is_refunded(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    cid = make_character(client, h, pid)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/characters/{cid}/generate", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/characters/{cid}", headers=h).json()["sheet_status"] == "failed"
+    assert credits(client, h) == 500
+
+
+def test_successful_character_sheet_is_charged(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    cid = make_character(client, h, pid)
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/characters/{cid}/generate", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert credits(client, h) == 480
+
+
+def test_failed_worldview_augment_is_refunded(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/projects/worldview/augment", headers=h, json={"description": "A city", "title": "T"})
+    assert r.status_code == 500
+    assert credits(client, h) == 500
+
+
+def test_failed_scene_render_is_refunded(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/scenes/render", headers=h, json={"prompt": "a bus at night"})
+    assert r.status_code == 500
+    assert credits(client, h) == 500
+
+
+def test_failed_style_preview_is_refunded(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/styles", headers=h, json={"name": "Ink", "description": "ink wash"})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert credits(client, h) == 500
+
+
+def test_refund_is_recorded_as_a_transaction(client):
+    from sqlmodel import Session, select
+    from app.db.engine import engine
+    from app.models.models import CreditTransaction
+
+    h = signup(client)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    client.post(f"{API}/scenes/render", headers=h, json={"prompt": "x"})
+    with Session(engine) as s:
+        rows = s.exec(select(CreditTransaction)).all()
+    kinds = sorted((t.action_type, t.amount) for t in rows)
+    assert ("generate_panel_image", -12) in kinds
+    assert ("refund_generate_panel_image", 12) in kinds
+
+
+def test_credit_history_lists_charge_and_refund_newest_first(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    ws = client.get(f"{API}/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["id"]
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    client.post(f"{API}/scenes/render", headers=h, json={"prompt": "x"})
+    FakeGemini.fail = False
+    client.post(f"{API}/scenes/render", headers=h, json={"prompt": "x"})
+    r = client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{ws}/credits/history", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    items = r.json()
+    assert [(i["action"], i["amount"]) for i in items] == [
+        ("generate_panel_image", -12),
+        ("refund_generate_panel_image", 12),
+        ("generate_panel_image", -12),
+    ]
+    assert all("created_at" in i for i in items)
+
+
+def test_credit_history_includes_daily_refill(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    ws = client.get(f"{API}/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["id"]
+    client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{ws}", headers=h)  # triggers the daily refill
+    items = client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{ws}/credits/history", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(i["action"], i["amount"]) for i in items] == [("daily_refill", 50)]
+
+
+def test_credit_history_is_404_for_non_members(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    other = signup(client, email="other@example.com")
+    ws = client.get(f"{API}/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["id"]
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{ws}/credits/history", headers=other).status_code == 404
+    missing = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{missing}/credits/history", headers=other).status_code == 404
